raw_definitions: Definisi : 2. filming, penggambaran, pemfileman: ~ recommenced as soon as the rain stopped, penggambaran bermula lagi sebaik sahaja hujan berhenti; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : we could hear ~ from the other side of the river, kami terdengar tembak-menembak dr seberang sungai; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ migrating birds should be made illegal, menembak burung yg berpindah-pindah patut diharamkan; there was a ~ incident in the town last night, ada kejadian tembak-menembak di pekan malam tadi; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. act of firing guns (at so., st) menembak; (reciprocally) tembak-menembak: ~ in this part of the forest is forbidden, menembak di bahagian hutan ini dilarang; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : sakit yg mencucuk-cucuk; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : adj (of pain) darting, mencucuk-cucuk: ~ pains, rasa (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
